name: junkdrawer-dashboard
description: Renders .dash files as command-center dashboards the agent can drive

languageModelTools.name: junkdrawer_updateDashboard
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Update a Junk Drawer dashboard (.dash file). A dashboard has TYPED VARIABLES (declared in the file, shown as filter chips) and CARDS (metric tiles). Cards are either static (a fixed 'value') or live (a 'metric' name resolved against the current variables and formatted per 'format'). Read the .dash file first to see its declared variables and their current values - everything you need is in that file. Use setVariables to change a variable's value (the most common action, e.g. change the time window or currency); use 'variables' to declare/replace the variable list; use 'cards' to replace all cards; use title/subtitle to rename. Pass filePath for a specific file or omit it for the active dashboard. Typed variable values are validated - allowed values: period (a time window) is one of 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, 14d, 30d, 90d, mtd, qtd, ytd, 12mo, all; currency is one of USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY, INR, BRL, MXN, BTC, ETH; enum is one of its declared options; number is any number within min/max; boolean is true/false; string is free text.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative path to the .dash file to update. Omit to use the active dashboard.

setVariables.description: Patch the values of existing declared variables, e.g. {"period":"90d","currency":"EUR"}. Values are validated against each variable's type.

variables.description: Declare/replace the full list of typed variables. Each renders as a filter chip.

type.description: Variable type. period and currency have built-in allowed values.

label.description: Optional display label for the chip.

cards.description: Metric cards to display. Replaces all existing cards when provided.

metric.description: Live metric name resolved against the variables (e.g. mrr, arr, revenue, users, signups, sessions, mau, churn, conversion, nps, or any custom name). Omit for a static card.

value.description: Static value, e.g. '$1.2M'. Used when 'metric' is omitted.

format.description: How to format a live metric value. Currency uses the dashboard's currency variable.

hint.description: Optional small hint under the value.
